snippet.title: Yankee Rabbits | First Look | indie.io
snippet.description:
The world ended — and the rabbits won. 🐇💥

Yankee Rabbits is a chaotic first-person shooter where pink, bat-swinging humanoid rabbits have taken over the city — and you, a mysterious anime girl, are somehow expected to clean up their mess.

Blast through 10 stages of escalating carnage, survive endless waves, double-jump through platforming chaos, and dodge a corrupt cop who blames you for everything while attacking you on sight.

It’s cute. It’s brutal. It makes no sense. Perfect.

📅 Coming soon to Steam — https://bit.ly/YankeeRabbits

#YankeeRabbits #FPS #IndieGame #Anime #Chaos
